name: critic P30 run 5 - what a real confirm does on the shadowed containers, and the two unstandable ones

steps.eval: (async () => { const F = (await import('/src/world/field.js')).Field; window.__F = F; return 'ok'; })()

steps.note: 1. a real confirm press at the cottage wardrobe the HUD invites you to Search

steps.eval: (async () => { window.__DQ.teleport('int_cottage'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1600)); const t = window.__DQ.state().treasure.here.find(c => c.id === 'ct_wardrobe'); window.__DQ.teleport('int_cottage', t.x, t.z + 1.3); window.__DQ.face(180); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); return JSON.stringify({prompt: (window.__DQ.state().hud||{}).prompt, near: window.__DQ.state().player.near}); })()

steps.note: 2. the same at Old Hob's bookshelf

steps.eval: (async () => { window.__DQ.teleport('int_hob'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1600)); const t = window.__DQ.state().treasure.here.find(c => c.id === 'hb_books'); window.__DQ.teleport('int_hob', t.x, t.z + 1.3); window.__DQ.face(180); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); return JSON.stringify({prompt: (window.__DQ.state().hud||{}).prompt, near: window.__DQ.state().player.near}); })()

steps.note: 3. the two Puddlewick containers with nowhere to stand - fine ring scan, 48 directions x 5 radii

steps.eval: (async () => { window.__DQ.teleport('puddlewick'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1800)); const m = window.__F.map; const out = []; for (const id of ['pw_barrel_mill','pw_mill_stone']) { const c = window.__DQ.state().treasure.here.find(q => q.id === id); const hits = []; for (let a = 0; a < 48; a++) { for (const rad of [0.9, 1.1, 1.3, 1.5, 1.7]) { const th = (a / 48) * Math.PI * 2; const x = c.x + Math.cos(th) * rad, z = c.z + Math.sin(th) * rad; if (m.clear && !m.clear(x, z)) continue; const h = m.nearestInteractable(x, z, (c.x - x) / rad, (c.z - z) / rad, 2.4); if (h && h.target.id === id) hits.push({rad, a}); } } out.push({id, x: c.x, z: c.z, holds: c.holds, standable: hits.length, sample: hits.slice(0, 3)}); } return JSON.stringify(out); })()

steps.note: 4. and can the hero WALK to those spots from the village spawn - is the mill yard even inside the map

steps.eval: (async () => { const m = window.__F.map; const out = []; for (const id of ['pw_barrel_mill','pw_mill_stone']) { const c = window.__DQ.state().treasure.here.find(q => q.id === id); out.push({id, x: c.x, z: c.z, clearOnTop: m.clear ? m.clear(c.x, c.z) : null, walkY: m.walkY ? m.walkY(c.x, c.z) : null}); } return JSON.stringify(out); })()

(async () => { const c = window.__DQ.state().treasure.here.find(q => q.id === 'pw_barrel_mill'); window.__DQ.teleport('puddlewick', c.x, c.z + 2.2); window.__DQ.face(180); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); return JSON.stringify({p: window.__DQ.state().player, prompt: (window.__DQ.state().hud||{}).prompt}); })()

steps.note: 5. the always-full pot at the dead end - the one thing WORLD-BIBLE promises always pays

steps.eval: (async () => { const m = window.__F.map; const p = m.props.find(q => q.name === 'a pot at the dead end'); if (!p) return 'no such prop'; window.__DQ.teleport('puddlewick', p.x, p.z + 1.3); window.__DQ.face(180); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); return JSON.stringify({prompt: (window.__DQ.state().hud||{}).prompt, near: window.__DQ.state().player.near}); })()
